text: TreeListboxMixin uses metaKey on macOS and ctrlKey elsewhere for additive selection. The tests use accelKey so the harness follows the platform. Shift adds the visible range; Escape keeps the last interacted selected row. Do not substitute one platform-specific modifier in shared tests or claim Ctrl is the only supported interaction from a historic commit description. Source/test assertions are checked; no native keyboard or screen reader run.
title: Use the platform accelerator for tree multiselection
